newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal EDP valued at up to 1.7 trln esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal EDP valued at up to 1.7 trln esc.

text.p: Consultants advising the Portuguese government on the privatisation of electricity concern EDP valued the group at up to 1.7 trillion escudos, Secretary of State for Industry and Energy Jose Penedos said.
"The top evaluation was 1,700 billion escudos," he told Reuters.

The studies were carried out by Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI), Goldman Sachs and NM Rothschild & Sons, the consortium which was subsequently named global coordinator for the sale, Banco Cisf, Kleinwort Benson and Lehman Brothers and Banco Essi, Merrill Lynch, SBC Warburg and UBS.

Penedos did not say to which of the consultants the top evaluation belonged. The government plans to sell off up to 49 percent of EDP early this year in what would be the largest privatisation to-date.
